desc:
Start from zero in Riverbank Village! Beg passers-by for spare change, collect junk, trade it for bottle caps, and rise to become the richest hobo in the city.

🪙 Beg on the streets: busier spots pay more
🎒 The shabbier your outfit, the sorrier people feel
⬆️ Upgrade your voice, sad face, sack and sandals
👑 Finish the Cardboard King's quests to earn Access Cards to new areas
🔄 Rebirth for a permanent money bonus
📅 Daily and weekly quests plus 7-day login rewards

Join the Pos Ronda Games group for a permanent +10% money bonus!
